title: Trump Immigration Court Deporting Unaccompanied Children As Young As 2
description: At this point, no decent, empathetic human being could deny that under President Donald Trump, immigration enforcement has become a regular practice of cruelty, inhumanity, and general heartlessness. While Trump continues to welcome white Afrikaners from South Africa into the country as refugees to save them from a fictional “white genocide,” his administration is canceling protections for Black and brown migrants who are actually in the country to escape the deadly violence of their homelands,…
author: Zack Linly

title: Department Of Education Strips Title IX Protections From LGBTQ+ Students
description: Project 2025’s game plan is taking shape. Trans people, who make up less than 1% of the adult population , are again under attack in a culture war that grows staler by the week while grocery bills keep climbing . In the latest, the Department of Education on Monday formally rescinded the Biden administration’s 2024 Title IX rule.
author: Angela M. Bronner

title: Federal Judge Lifts Oakland Police Department’s Consent Decree
description: On Tuesday, a federal judge lifted a consent decree on the Oakland Police Department that had been in place for 23 years. AP reports that the consent decree was originally issued in 2003. The OPD made headlines in 2000 after a rookie officer spoke out against a group of officers called the Oakland “riders.” The riders were found to have conducted false arrests, planted evidence, and regularly used excessive force while policing the predominantly Black area of West Oakland.
author: Joe Jurado

title: DHS Uses NFL Legend’s Image In Anti-Migrant Propaganda
description: The National Football League has asked the Department of Homeland Security to take down a social media video that uses highlights of Hall of Fame safety Brian Dawkins to promote the Trump administration’s immigration crackdowns. So far, the agency is refusing. NFL spokesman Brian McCarthy confirmed Monday that the league had asked DHS to remove the video, the Guardian reports.
author: Angela M. Bronner

title: Why The Courtside Finger Pointing At A’ja Wilson Unearths A History Of Racism And Respectability Politics for Black Women
description: As Black women in America, we are constantly expected to possess an endless reservoir of grace and composure while absorbing disrespect and racism. When a white male spectator aggressively pointed his finger at Las Vegas Aces star A’ja Wilson during a playoff match, a collective shockwave went through our community. Wilson promptly defended her space.
author: Nicky Childers

title: A’ja Wilson Receives King Center’s 2027 Youth Influencer Award
description: The King Center announced Wednesday that Las Vegas Aces star A’ja Wilson will receive its 2027 Beloved Community Youth Influencer Award. In a statement posted to social media , the King Center said that Wilson received the award in recognition of her work through the A’ja Wilson Foundation. Wilson’s foundation focuses on helping young girls with dyslexia build confidence and navigate their mental health struggles.
author: Joe Jurado

title: Cornell Gang Rape: Fraternity Text Messages Related To Investigation Revealed As Mayor Shuts Down Event Permits
description: It’s easy to imagine that the seven members of Cornell University’s Chi Pi fraternity thought all of their troubles had faded away to obscurity after they were accused of drugging and gang-raping a female student for several hours in October 2024. Since authorities had reportedly declined to press any charges after the alleged rape was reported the following month, they likely thought they were safe, not just from prosecution, but from public scrutiny and outrage.
author: Zack Linly

title: Wisconsin High School Students Stage Walkout In Support Of Nolan Wells
description: It has been nearly three months since Nolan Wells went to a party with several friends on an island off the coast of Mississippi on July 4, and we still have no idea why he died on that trip instead of returning with his travelling companions. Last week, a Mississippi grand jury determined that there was no evidence of criminal wrongdoing in Wells’ death, and that there was no evidence that his so-called friends had anything to do with his death.
author: Zack Linly

title: Notable Black Folks Who Died In 2026
description: UPDATE — Wednesday, September 30, 2026, 11:17 a.m. EST: We love our Black celebrities . Period. No matter how famous they get or how big the stages become, there’s always a different kind of pride that comes with seeing Black folks win. It feels personal, like their success is proof that we can make it too, that our stories matter, and that our voices deserve to be heard on the biggest platforms possible.
author: Davonta Herring

title: GOP Senator Blocks Bipartisan Effort To Protect Kennedy Center From Trump
description: Donald Trump, his administration, and his hand-picked board at the John F. Kennedy Center for the Performing Arts are essentially holding the institution hostage until Trump’s name is restored to a building that was meant to honor an assassinated president of the United States. As we previously reported , Trump and the board have both warned that the Kennedy Center would go bankrupt and could be demolished due to disrepair if the current president’s name wasn’t restored.
author: Zack Linly

title: Brad Pitt’s Daughter Officially Drops His Last Name
description: Today in celebrity drama, one of the children adopted by Brad Pitt and Angelina Jolie has legally dropped Pitt’s last name. TMZ reports that 21-year-old Zahara Jolie filed a motion to change her last name with the Los Angeles Superior Court earlier this year. A brief hearing was held on Monday, where a judge granted her request. “There being no objections, the petition for change of name is granted,” the Sept. 28 minute order states. “The Decree is signed and filed.
author: Joe Jurado

title: In 2026, Azeez Al-Shaair’s ‘Controversial’ Eye Blacks Are The Closest Thing To Athlete Activism [Op-Ed]
description: Raised fists stripped Tommie Smith and John Carlos of their Olympic medals. Kneeling got Colin Kaepernick blackballed. Valuing life keeps getting Azeez Al-Shaair fined. Nowadays, this is what “buck-breaking” looks like. The Houston Texans linebacker has become quite the “disturbance” this year, depending on your geopolitical views and sense of humanity, as he’s been in the news more for his equipment choices than for his on-field production.
author: Carron J. Phillips

title: Black Man Released From Death Row After Crime Scene DNA Doesn’t Match Him
description: In news that yet again justifies distrust in the American justice system, a Black man in Utah who spent over 40 years on death row was released this week after DNA evidence from the crime scene didn’t match him. CBS News reports that 71-year-old Douglas Stewart Carter was sentenced to death in 1985 over the murder of Eva Olesen. Olesen was the aunt of Provo’s police chief at the time.
author: Joe Jurado

title: Trump Admin To Bar Loans For College Degrees That Don’t Make Enough Money
description: The Trump administration keeps finding fresh ways to make this country worse while calling it making America great again . President Donald Trump has already done his best to make the nation unaffordable, to normalize white nationalist bigotry, and to make policy out of scientific illiteracy, and it should never be forgotten that he, his administration, and his GOP enablers are also working hard to give the U.S. a populace that is less educated and far less prone to critical thinking.
author: Zack Linly

title: Stevie Wonder Releases 4 Unvaulted Tracks From ‘Songs In The Key Of Life’ Ahead Of 50th Anniversary Tour
description: Alright, my fellow Stevie Wonder fans, this is not a drill. If you ask most Stevie fans what the singer, songwriter, musician and music producer’s best album is, they’ll tell you it’s 1976’s Songs in the Key of Life . Well, on Monday, which marks the 50th anniversary of the album that won Album of the Year at the Grammys in ’76, Wonder blessed the world with four unvaulted tracks from recording sessions during the time the album was recorded.
author: Zack Linly

title: Galveston Cop Who Fired 8 Shots At Unarmed Man Won’t Face Charges
description: A Galveston, Texas, police officer who shot and killed Randy Martin during a traffic stop in May will not face criminal charges, even as newly released footage fuels doubts about the officer’s account. Houston Public Media reports that a grand jury decided not to take action against the officer who killed Martin, 47. The Texas Rangers investigated the shooting, and the district attorney’s office presented the case, which included video of the incident.
author: Angela M. Bronner

title: Texas Redistricting Effort Could Backfire On Republicans
description: Last year, Texas triggered the nationwide redistricting battle at President Donald Trump’s behest. As the midterm election approaches, Texas’ new congressional map may backfire on Republicans. You love to see it. According to PBS, the Texas redistricting effort largely banked on the GOP maintaining the gains they made with Latino voters in the 2024 election. There’s just this small, growing problem that Latino voters are increasingly turning against the Republican Party.
author: Joe Jurado

title: Stroke, Cancer, High Blood Pressure: ‘Old People’ Diseases Are Hitting Young Black Women Hardest
description: Stroke, cancer, and high blood pressure have long been filed under mee-maw and paw-paw problems. New research says it’s time to rethink that, especially for young Black women. According to CNN , a study published Sept. 23 in the journal Neurology found that stroke rates among adults ages 20 to 54 nearly doubled over almost three decades, climbing from 33.9 cases per 100,000 people in 1993-94 to 62.2 per 100,000 in 2020.
author: Angela M. Bronner

title: NY Prosecutors Reopen Investigation Into Gang Rape Allegations At Cornell University Following Lawsuit
description: A former Cornell University student has alleged that in October 2024, she was drugged and gang raped for several hours by seven members of the college’s Chi Pi fraternity. According to her attorney, the allegations were adjudicated without a single accused member of the frat facing criminal charges or receiving any punishment.
author: Zack Linly

title: Lanterns Episode 7: Hal Jordan Confronts His Past And Future
description: We’ve reached the penultimate episode of Lanterns, which made the unusual but appreciated choice to dig deeper into Hal Jordan’s background instead of pushing the core mystery forward. The episode opens in 1975, where we see a young Hal sitting in his baseball coach’s office. His dad pulls up, and we see how Hal’s inherent arrogance is bolstered by his dad, Martin Jordan. The coach tells Martin that Hal refused to hand the ball to a substitute pitcher, which led to the team forfeiting.
author: Joe Jurado

title: Tell The Truth, Shame The Devil, Though This Devil Has No Shame
description: Dr. Lonnie Bunch, the outgoing Secretary of the Smithsonian, had a few parting words for the president and those of his ilk who think that even talking about enslavement is somehow unpatriotic. Speaking Friday at the 10th anniversary celebration of the National Museum of African American History and Culture, the museum he built from scratch as its founding director, Bunch argued that slavery is “foundational” to understanding the United States.
author: Angela M. Bronner

title: WNBA Playoffs Are Here: Everything You Need To Know
description: The road to a WNBA championship officially began Sunday, September 27, with eight teams still standing after a regular season that rarely gave anybody much time to get comfortable. The Minnesota Lynx finished with the league’s best record for the second straight season, the Golden State Valkyries climbed all the way to the No.
author: Davonta Herring

title: Surviving Trump: Supporters Turn On Trump Over Iran, Epstein, And Taxpayer-Funded Ads [Op-Ed]
description: Welcome back for another episode of Surviving Trump, our regular column where we highlight President Donald Trump’s most recent blunders, L’s and displays of incompetence, corruption and bigotry. It’s a full-time job and nobody has to do it, but everybody should, because government-sponsored propaganda should never go unchallenged, especially when it’s being played on a 24/7 MAGA loop.
author: Zack Linly

title: Trump DOJ Drops Dozens Of School Desegregation Cases, But The Most Segregated Schools Are In The North
description: The Trump administration is walking away from one of the federal government’s oldest tools for enforcing Brown v. Board of Education . The Justice Department said Thursday it has ended more than 50 decades-old consent decrees aimed at undoing Jim Crow-era school segregation, CBS News reports . Harmeet Dhillon, who heads the department’s Civil Rights Division, called the orders onerous and outdated. She said federal oversight no longer reflects what classrooms look like today.
author: Angela M. Bronner

title: Georgia Mother Shanteria ‘Tia’ Mosely Found Dead After Family’s Search; 18-Year-Old Charged With Murder
description: A 26-year-old Georgia mother is dead, and an 18-year-old man has been charged with her murder after her family tracked her to a Smyrna, Ga., apartment complex and found her remains. Smyrna police charged Kingston Lammar Bradley with malice murder on Friday (Sept. 25) in the death of Shanteria “Tia” Mosely, known to loved ones as “KT,” FOX 5 Atlanta reports . Bradley had already been charged with concealing the death of another.
author: Angela M. Bronner

title: Police Say Tasia Fortune’s Hanging Was ‘Staged’
description: The mysterious hanging of 29-year-old Tasia Fortune is coming closer to closure. On Friday, a police detective testified that Fortune was first killed in a dispute over drugs, and her body subsequently hung from a tree in a “staged” lynching, according to the Washington Post . The Post reports that “Fortune was killed in a disagreement about drugs, and she fought hard with her attackers before she was killed,” Jackson police Detective Samuel Dukes told the court.
author: Angela M. Bronner

title: California Sheriff Ordered To Return Over 600K Ballots
description: It’s crazy how the people who keep yapping about “protecting election security” are the ones who keep infringing on election security. On Thursday, the California Supreme Court ordered Chad Bianco, the Republican sheriff of Riverside County, to return nearly 650,000 ballots he seized from election officials during an investigation.
author: Joe Jurado

title: FAFO: Credit Union CEO Out After Posting Pic Of Her Family In ‘Lake America’ Shirts
description: In today’s episode of How TF You Let Trump Get You Fired On Your Day Off?, the CEO of a U.S.-based credit union is no longer the CEO of a U.S.-based credit union because she went full MAGA when you never go full MAGA , by posting an AI-generated photo of her and her family wearing “Lake America” sweatshirts.
author: Zack Linly

title: Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson Concerned Over Supreme Court’s Approval Of ‘Harmful Acts’
description: If you’ve spent the last year wondering how far the Supreme Court will go in allowing President Donald Trump to run roughshod over the United States’ foundational principles, you’re not alone. In fact, Justice Ketanji Brown Jackson has expressed concerns about how the court’s willingness to approve “harmful acts” by the Trump administration through emergency orders is damaging trust in the institution.
author: Joe Jurado

title: Woman Who Accused Jay-Z Of Sexual Assault Recants ‘False’ Allegations, Lawyers Say
description: The woman who accused Jay-Z of raping her when she was 13 — which happened in 2024, during the time a multitude of sexual assault allegations were leveled at Sean “Diddy” Combs — has recanted her allegations against the rapper and music mogul, saying those allegations were “false.” According to NBC News , lawyers representing Jay-Z, born Shawn Carter, said his accuser, identified only as Jane Doe, has not only admitted her allegations were “false,” but she said she “never met Mr.
author: Zack Linly
